headline: Finland orders Google to halt two data center builds
summary: Finland ordered Google to stop construction on two data centers after the company cleared forest before completing a required environmental impact assessment. Reports put the cleared area at roughly 300 hectares, and one outlet says authorities can no longer properly assess the altered site.

claims.statement: Finland ordered Google to halt construction on two data centers over the missing environmental assessment.

sources.quote: Finland orders halt to work on two Google data centres
Google told to halt work on datacentres in Finland over environmental concerns
Finland orders Google to stop work on two AI data centers over alleged deforestation

claims.statement: The halt follows reports that forest was cleared before Google completed the required environmental impact assessment.
